episodes.title: Leaving a Cult, Homelessness & Healing: Hollyanna Vellichor's Story
episodes.description:
Born into a high-control religious group, Hollyanna Vellichor made the choice to leave in 2022, and overnight she lost her home, her community, her business, her family and her relationship with her daughter. Homeless with her young son, she rebuilt from nothing and created Biocoding, a body-led approach to recovering from trauma and chronic pain.

On this episode of Eagle Freedom Presents, host and founder Deston Rogers sits down with Hollyanna Vellichor, a former British squad ice dancer, a cult survivor, and creator of BIO CODING, who joins from the United Kingdom. It's a story about finding your voice after being taught you didn't deserve one.

In this episode:
• What growing up inside a high-control religious group was like
• Being shunned and pushed to the bottom as a child
• How a five-year-old afraid of the ice ended up on the British ice dance squad
• Marriage, control, and how women were treated inside the group
• The incidents that became her breaking point
• Leaving, and losing nearly everything overnight
• The late-night calls that got her through "one more day"
• Homeless with her son, and the stranger who said "you're coming home with me"
• Feeling like two lives were overlapping in that first year out
• The moment a new direction "dropped in," and what Socrates taught her
• How she discovered the body's own language of movement
• Sensation tolerance: why learning to be uncomfortable makes you harder to manipulate
• Why she erased herself from her own work, and how she took it back
• One small step to reduce the load your body is carrying
• What freedom means to Hollyanna
